Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent

Class ModelCollection<T extends Model>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<T>
java.util.AbstractList<T>
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.ModelCollection<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the model class
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<T>, Collection<T>, List<T>, RandomAccess
public final class ModelCollection<T extends Model> extends AbstractList<T> implements RandomAccess
A read-only list of models, with Laravel's Eloquent collection helpers.

Every List method that changes the list throws UnsupportedOperationException. Unlike a plain list, contains(Object) matches a model as Model.is(Model) does and any other value as a primary key, as Laravel's collection does. Not safe to share across threads while its models change.

    • load

      public ModelCollection<T> load(String... relations)
      Eager loads relations onto every model, one query per relation per level, replacing any loaded value. Paths are as EloquentRelationQueries.with(String...).
      Parameters:
      relations - the relation paths, none null
      Returns:
      this collection
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a path is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the models are of more than one class, or a name:columns path lists an empty column
      RelationNotFoundException - if a path names no relation; checked before any query

    • loadMorph

      public ModelCollection<T> loadMorph(String relation, Map<Class<? extends Model>,List<String>> relations)
      Eager loads relations onto the owners the models' morph-to relation has loaded, choosing the relations by owner class: Laravel's loadMorph. The relation is first loaded on the models missing it, in one query per owner class; null owners are skipped, and the models themselves are not read again.
      Parameters:
      relation - the morph-to relation's name, never null
      relations - the relation paths to load, by owner class, never null
      Returns:
      this collection
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument, a class key or a path is null
      RelationNotFoundException - if a path names no relation of its owner class

    • loadMorphCount

      public ModelCollection<T> loadMorphCount(String relation, Map<Class<? extends Model>,List<String>> relations)
      Loads the number of related rows of each relation onto the owners the models' morph-to relation has loaded, choosing the relations by owner class: Laravel's loadMorphCount. The relation is first loaded on the models missing it; null owners are skipped.
      Parameters:
      relation - the morph-to relation's name, never null
      relations - the relation names to count, by owner class, never null
      Returns:
      this collection
      Throws:

      RelationNotFoundException - if a name is not a relation of its owner class

    • loadCount

      public ModelCollection<T> loadCount(String... relations)
      Loads a count(*) per relation onto every model, named relation_count, in one key-only query. A model whose row is gone or whose key is null is skipped; the values become original attributes, so they are not dirty.
      Parameters:
      relations - the relation names, each optionally "name as alias", none null; none, or an empty collection, runs nothing
      Returns:
      this collection
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a name is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the models are of more than one class
      RelationNotFoundException - if a name is not a relation of the model or is a dotted path; checked before any query
